definitions.explanation: A report or log summarizing the activities, progress, or events of a single day. Commonly used in workplaces, especially in Japanese companies where employees submit daily work reports.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{日報|にっぽう}を{書|か}いている。
examples.english: I write a daily report every day.

examples.japanese: {日報|にっぽう}を{上司|じょうし}に{提出|ていしゅつ}するのを{忘|わす}れた。
examples.english: I forgot to submit my daily report to my boss.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}{現場|げんば}では{安全|あんぜん}{管理|かんり}のために{日報|にっぽう}をつけることが{義務|ぎむ}づけられている。
examples.english: At construction sites, keeping a daily log is mandatory for safety management.

notes:
USAGE:
{日報|にっぽう} is standard workplace vocabulary in Japan. Many companies require employees to submit daily reports summarizing their work. It can also refer to daily logs kept at construction sites, medical facilities, or schools.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日報|にっぽう}を{書|か}く (to write a daily report)
- {日報|にっぽう}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する (to submit a daily report)
- {業務|ぎょうむ}{日報|にっぽう} (work daily report)
- {日報|にっぽう}をつける (to keep a daily log)

RELATED WORDS:
{週報|しゅうほう} is a weekly report, {月報|げっぽう} is a monthly report, and {年報|ねんぽう} is an annual report.
